requests.summary: The embedded Incident Action Drawer cannot safely issue HardRollback from Incident Detail because the detail packet does not provide a rollback target artifact ID.

details.reason_not_safe_to_guess: The current artifact ID in the incident payload is not guaranteed to be the intended rollback target.

requests.requested_follow_up: Publish the canonical rollback target source for HardRollback when launching the action drawer from Incident Detail, or extend the incident-detail packet with the required rollback target context.
